name: AH 5350
title: Advanced Medical Nutrition Therapy
description: Provides student with advanced nutrition therapy information for the effective treatment of complex medical problems. Emphasizes all aspects of the nutrition care process as it relates to medical conditions. The research regarding the physiological, pathological and metabolic basis for nutrient modifications will be emphasized.
requirement_description: Open only to Dietetics majors, others by consent of the Director of Dietetics.
